name: Articles
description: Long-form writing: owner-drafted articles with public permalinks and global search. The /articles/{article_id:uuid} permalink is a seeded 59 detail view (site_view_render) with an owner-aware editable/deletable detail block -- no bespoke per-article page. 0.3.0 deletes the bespoke /articles list page object too: it was ~90 lines of chrome around two generator calls with no business logic of its own, and is now a seeded VIEW record over the same `list` block /notes uses.
